'''Corey Faherty''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 Milwaukee tournament (20 May)]] on 20 May 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down with few characters (Operational Enforcement start)]], according to Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d776">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-milwaukee-wi-5-20-00d776/ milwaukee-wi-5-20-00], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-milwaukee-wi-5-20-00d776/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
Corey Faherty is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of one card.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card is in [[Virtual Block 6]], released 4 September 2009. The occasions named in the concept credits date from 2006.
One card in all (Concept: 1).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Corey Faherty|Corey Faherty]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>
